title: 第1636章 虚无空间第1635章 圣器水准
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
帝塔这一式攻击，已经时第二次施展，先前一次，是对苏星河发动必杀一击时，只可惜，被苏星河以某种玄妙的秘法逃脱。
这次施展，威力比第一次更甚，空间之力落在紫薇斩仙大阵屏障上，仿若撞在了豆腐上，阵法光幕，与空间一起，直接坍塌崩溃！
恐怖的威力，直接翻倍！
而帝塔眉心之处，一抹扎眼的殷红浮现，凝聚成一道诡异的羽翼铭文。
“巫灵燃烧？！帝塔首领，你疯了？！”
看到帝塔眉心浮现出的殷红羽翼铭文，同为巫族强者的祝青锋，像是见鬼了一样，惊声尖叫。
“我以圣族真血，祈求圣祖庇佑！”
帝塔像是完全没有听到祝青锋惊呼，即将冲出大阵之前，眉心殷红羽翼铭文，极速扩散，话音未落，羽翼铭文已经扩散到整张脸颊。
与此同时，蒂塔周身散发出一股刺鼻的血腥气息，整个人的修为，竟然再一次极速攀升！
如果说，先前在巫灵降临的加持下，他只是有了卡比化神的强大实力，这一刻，在这股血腥气息加持下，他的肉身也在极速蜕变！
一切看似缓慢，实际从帝塔瞬身冲击阵法屏障，到气息暴涨，不过转瞬之间。
苏星河将太乙天道剑凝聚到极限，在帝塔冲出紫薇斩仙大阵的前一瞬，一剑斩下！
“火、土、金，融合！”
苏星河暗自默念，体内三种基础属性之力，迅速凝聚！
三种属性之力融合，看似比火、土两种属性融合，只多了一种而已，但无论是难度，还是威力，都是成十倍、百倍的提升！
要知道，世间万物，在道法衍化中，不过是五行的具象化，就连风、雷、冰、光、暗，这五种变异属性，也是自五行基础属性衍化而来。
若世间万物，全部归于五行，那苏星河融合的融合火、土、金，三种属性，相当于融合了世间大部分的力量！
如此来看，威力又将是何等磅礴！
原本同样在凝聚太乙天道剑的封岳，感受到苏星河展现出的恐怖力量，周身气息不由一滞，险些功亏一篑！
“这是......太乙天道剑？”

封极修为最高，元婴八层的修为，与苏家族老苏忘机不相上下，见识也远在其他太上长老之上，可惜，他不是剑修，无法理解苏星河此时展现出的剑道真意。
不过，剑势蕴含的恐怖威能，他却是要比封岳感受到的更为真切。
他甚至可以肯定，苏星河这一剑的威能，已经超越了对方帝塔最强空间术法攻击！
“留下吧！”
苏星河没有回答封极的诧异询问，目光灼灼的盯着帝塔，人剑合一，以肉眼不可见的绝对速度，直接刺向了帝塔！
剑光所过之处，空间没有丝毫波动，甚至，连气息都不曾带起分毫，在没有时间法则加持之下，这方天地仿佛静止了。
封岳保持着惊呼时，张大的嘴巴，封仪正在催动体内法力，加持阵法，而流转的阵法气息，也在这一瞬间凝固！
content_en:
This attack by Emperor Ta was already used for the second time. The previous time was when he launched a fatal blow against Su Xinghe. Unfortunately, Su Xinghe escaped with some mysterious secret method.
This time it was used, the power was even greater than the first time. The power of space fell on the barrier of Ziwei Immortal Killing Formation, as if it hit tofu. The formation light curtain, together with the space, collapsed directly!
The terrifying power is doubled!
And between Emperor Ta's brows, a dazzling bright red appeared, condensing into a strange wing inscription.
"The witch spirit is burning?! Leader of the Imperial Tower, are you crazy?!"
Seeing the Yin Hong Wings inscription appearing between the eyebrows of the Emperor Tower, Zhu Qingfeng, who is also a strong man of the Wu clan, screamed as if he had seen a ghost.
"I use the true blood of the saints to pray for the blessings of the saints!"
Di Ta seemed not to have heard Zhu Qingfeng's exclamation at all. Just before he was about to rush out of the formation, the red wing inscription spread rapidly between his eyebrows. Before he finished speaking, the wing inscription had spread to his entire cheek.
At the same time, Dita's body exuded a pungent smell of blood, and her cultivation level increased rapidly again!
If, previously, with the blessing of the Witch Spirit, he only had the powerful strength of Kirby's transformation into a god, at this moment, with the blessing of this bloody aura, his physical body is also undergoing rapid transformation!
Everything seems to be slow, but in fact, from the imperial tower's sudden impact on the formation barrier to the surge of breath, it only takes a blink of an eye.
Su Xinghe condensed the Taiyi Tiandao Sword to the limit, and struck down the Emperor Pagoda with one sword just before he rushed out of the Ziwei Immortal Slaying Formation!
"Fire, earth, and metal merge!"
Su Xinghe muttered to himself, and the power of the three basic attributes in his body quickly condensed!
The fusion of the power of three attributes seems to be only one more than the fusion of fire and earth attributes, but both the difficulty and power are increased tenfold or a hundredfold!
You must know that all things in the world are just the embodiment of the five elements in the evolution of Taoism. Even the five mutated attributes of wind, thunder, ice, light, and darkness are also derived from the basic attributes of the five elements.
If all things in the world belong to the Five Elements, then Su Xinghe's fusion of fire, earth, and metal is equivalent to integrating most of the power in the world!
Judging from this, how majestic the power will be!
Feng Yue, who was also condensing the Taiyi Tiandao Sword, felt the terrifying power displayed by Su Xinghe, and his aura couldn't help but stagnated, and he almost failed!
"This is... Taiyi Tiandao Sword?"
Feng Ji has the highest cultivation level. His cultivation level at the eighth level of Nascent Soul is on par with Su Wangji, the elder of the Su family, and his knowledge is far above that of the other supreme elders. Unfortunately, he is not a swordsman and cannot understand the true meaning of the swordsmanship shown by Su Xinghe at this time.
However, the terrifying power contained in the sword's power was more real to him than Feng Yue felt.
He was even certain that the power of Su Xinghe's sword had surpassed the strongest space spell attack from the opponent's Imperial Tower!
"Stay!"
Su Xinghe did not answer Feng Ji's surprised inquiry. He stared at the Imperial Tower with burning eyes. He and his sword merged into one, and stabbed directly at the Imperial Tower at an absolute speed invisible to the naked eye!
Wherever the sword light passed, the space did not fluctuate at all, and even the breath was not carried at all. Without the blessing of the law of time, the world seemed to be still.
Feng Yue kept exclaiming with his mouth wide open. Feng Yi was activating the magic power in his body to strengthen the formation, and the flowing aura of the formation also solidified at this moment!
